sources.title: BF16 Component-Product Emulation of FP32 and FP64 GEMM on Intel AMX
sources.snippet: Modern CPUs increasingly integrate high-throughput matrix engines optimized for low-precision AI workloads, while many scientific computing applications still rely on FP32 and FP64 GEMM to meet their numerical accuracy requirements. This mismatch motivates an algorithmic bridge that uses low-precision matrix products to emulate higher-precision GEMM.
